title: Disposability
notes: | 2026-10-26 realign: text "Your other creatures' buffs persist through death"; the code also keeps the holder's own buffs and every minion. Kept as leave (superset; the text doesn't say the holder's buffs are removed) - flagged for the user. User 2026-10-26: 'other creatures means other creatures' — only the holder's OTHER creatures' buffs persist; the holder's own buffs and minions do not. 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Disposability on creature A; creature B (ally) with a buff and a minion dies: B's buff persists, B's minion is removed. A itself dies with a buff: the buff is removed.

release_notes.intended: Your other creatures' buffs persist through death.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the holder's own buffs and every minion persisted as well.
release_notes.fix: Now only your other creatures' buffs persist; the holder's own buffs and minions are removed on death as usual.
